rca_of_the_issue: Advisor hover-reveal bug RCA: the useEffect on lines 226-235 of Dashboard.jsx has both `chatActive` and `advisorCollapsed` in its dependency array. The intent is 'collapse once when chatActive becomes true'. But because `advisorCollapsed` is also a dep, the effect fires every time advisorCollapsed flips. So when the mousemove listener (lines 236-247) does setAdvisorCollapsed(false) on right-edge hover, the dep change re-runs the collapse effect, which sees chatActive=true && !advisorCollapsed and immediately calls setAdvisorCollapsed(true) again. Net effect: hover-reveal is instantly reverted. Reproduction: login → focus chat → type → move mouse to far right → observe ds2-advisor-real width remains 0. Fix: remove advisorCollapsed from the deps (eslint-disable-next-line) OR add a guard checking advisorAutoRef.current to ensure the auto-collapse only fires once per chatActive transition. Sidebar bug RCA: sidebarPinned defaults to true, so the chatActive-driven collapse logic on line 286 is short-circuited.
